main_body: Flat grass ground patch (4x3 tiles) seen from above; terrain tile, not a standing object
top_band: none - uniform grass field with scattered lighter and darker dots; no top/front structure (terrain)
evidence: Terrain ground tile with no standing volume. The column scan shows only a mid-green #628433 with occasional #7c9c42 speckle rows, which is a repeating grass texture and not a top/front structure. The 3/4 contract does not apply to flat ground, so there is nothing to fail.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 4 distinct colours and a median of 4 per 16x16 tile, against 26 colours per tile and 80 colours total for the reference grass. Its texture is a small set of repeated stamp motifs (a dark blob, a checker clump, single dark dots) on one base green, so it tiles visibly and looks mechanical. Only 3 usable green steps. Flat-fill coverage is low at 7%, and there are no outlines. Next to the reference grass, with its tufts and several greens, it is much thinner and flatter, even though the palette is a different locked theme.
